summary: Thursday's close showed broad de-risking accelerate: the VIX jumped to 28.4, more than three standard deviations above its average, as equities fell sharply across the board. A firming dollar near 103.83 pushed real yields higher, pinning gold's rebound, while bitcoin extended its slide to a 26.5% monthly drawdown with RSI near 11, deep capitulation territory. Bonds were the lone beneficiary of the flight to safety.
tweet: VIX spiked to 28.4 and the dollar held near 104, crushing gold while equities sank and bitcoin's RSI near 11 signals outright capitulation.
